svg.title: DEFADE Memory
svg.desc: Every scan is kept: bundlers, snipers, fresh wallets, insiders, funders, operator bands, token creators and launch tool fleets. When a token later rugs, every wallet on it is marked, so known hands are flagged before they act.
svg.text: HAVE WE SEEN THESE HANDS BEFORE?
Rug crews rotate tokens faster than they rotate wallets, funders and habits. Every scan is kept, so a
wallet can be flagged before it does anything on this token, and the memory grows with every scan.

g.text: every wallet caught in a launch bundle
kept, never held against a wallet alone
under a week old when seen holding
top holders moving value to each other
who seeded several holders of one token
wallets tied by the same private funders
with the wallet that first funded them
the bundler wallets behind each tool

svg.text: when a token later rugs, every wallet on it is marked
A SNIPER IS NOT AN OPERATOR.
Bots hit everything; a repeat offender bundled,
funded or was an insider on an earlier rug.
AN EXCHANGE IS NOT A FUNDER.
Shared exchanges, bridges and payout services
